descriptionByLocale.it:

• Cosa offriamo - Attività significativa in un ambiente di lavoro multiculturale, gerarchie piatte Descrizione SPITEX BASILEA è una fondazione senza scopo di lucro senza scopo di lucro con mandato di prestazioni del Cantone di Basilea Città. descriptionByLocale.en:
Mansioni - Providing on-call service for nursing emergencies in Basel, Riehen and Bettingen - Assessing acute nursing situations and providing emergency measures - Cooperation with emergency centres and emergency services in Basel-Stadt - Supporting customers and relatives in emergency and crisis situations - Assuming further measures to ensure safety Props - Basic training for nurses HF/FH - Competent and rapid assessment of nursing emergency situations - Independence and high flexibility - Appreciative and clear communication - Peace and overview, even in hectic situations - Mobility with your own car or Velo
• Cosa offriamo - Meaningful work in a multicultural working environment, flat hierarchies Descrizione SPITEX BASEL is a non-profit foundation with a performance mandate from the Canton of Basel-Stadt. As a leading Spitex organisation with a public service mission, SPITEX BASEL offers comprehensive services in the areas of outpatient care as well as housekeeping and care. Children, adolescents and adults are supported in every phase of life.

• Selbstständigkeit und hohe Flexibilität

• Mobilität mit eigenem Auto oder Velo Wir bieten: Sinnstiftende Tätigkeit in einem multikulturellen Arbeitsumfeld, flache Hierarchien SPITEX BASEL ist eine gemeinnützige, nicht gewinnorientierte Stiftung mit Leistungsauftrag des Kantons Basel-Stadt. descriptionByLocale.en:
Tasks - Promoting and demanding efficient and high-quality nursing care for chronically ill people - Professional leadership in shared leadership - Supporting nursing teams in clinical decisions and in complex care situations - Observing and reflecting on nursing processes - Promoting reflectivity and critical thinking in the form of case discussions and ethical case analyses - Promoting the culture of change in favour of high-quality, evidence-based person-centred nursing practice and interprofessional cooperation - Implementing evidence-based guidelines - Schools and accompanying the nursing team in the event of change - Active participation in internal and external specialist committees
• Requirements - Several years of professional experience in nursing - Bachelor's degree in nursing or equivalent training with motivation for a master's degree - Expertise and experience in dealing with chronically ill people - Analytical thinking and solution-oriented approaches - Distinctive leadership skills and self-competencies
• We offer - Meaningful work in a multicultural working environment, flat hierarchies SPITEX BASEL is a non-profit, non-profit foundation with a performance mandate from the Canton of Basel-City. As a leading Spitex organisation with a public service mission, SPITEX BASEL offers comprehensive services in the areas of outpatient care as well as housekeeping and care.
